name: crm-commercial
description: CRM commercial pour cabinets de prestations esthetiques (projet jumeau non-HDS de crm-chirurgien). Multi-tenant, Next.js 15 + Express + Prisma + Postgres.

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec backend npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec backend npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:seed-editor: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T backend npx tsx prisma/seed-editor.ts
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec backend npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.db:studio: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec backend npx prisma studio
scripts.test: npm -w apps/backend test && npm -w apps/frontend test
scripts.lint: npm -w apps/frontend run lint && npm -w apps/backend run lint
scripts.build: npm -w apps/frontend run build && npm -w apps/backend run build
